title: PPG-MS30 — Operator UX Hardening (WCAG + touch + keyboard)
description: Closes the UX-rigor gap surfaced by R07 scrutiny (score 58). WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with color-blind palette + icon redundancy, ≥44×44 px touch targets for shop tablets, full keyboard navigation, operator-voice copy review, undo/redo + autosave + multi-operator conflict resolution.
rationale: Closes the UX-rigor gap surfaced by R07 scrutiny (score 58). WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with color-blind palette + icon redundancy, ≥44×44 px touch targets for shop tablets, full keyboard navigation, operator-voice copy review, undo/redo + autosave + multi-operator conflict resolution.

units.title: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance + axe-core CI gate
units.scope: Color-blind palette (4.5:1 contrast + icon redundancy on all verdict banners). axe-core in CI; fail PR on AA violation. Per PPG-MS14 banner + PPG-MS17 ensemble panel + PPG-MS16 dashboard.

units.title: Touch targets ≥44×44 px + shop-tablet validation
units.scope: All interactive elements (pocket grid, toggles, accept-fix buttons) ≥44×44 px CSS. Validated on 3 representative shop tablets (iPad 10", Surface, Android 10").

units.title: Full keyboard navigation + ARIA labels + focus management
units.scope: Tab order documented; Esc cancels; Enter accepts primary action; ARIA labels on every interactive element. After BLOCK, focus moves to first failed predicate; after auto-fix accept, focus moves to Re-Run.

units.title: Operator-voice copy review + every error string rewritten
units.scope: Every error/warning/info message reviewed by operator panel (N≥3). Pattern: location anchor + plain-language cause + button-shaped fix. Lock copy via i18n with English-shop-floor as default.

units.title: Undo/redo + autosave indicator + multi-operator CRDT/LWW conflict
units.scope: Wizard state has undo/redo stack; autosave indicator visible; multi-operator concurrent edit handled with operator-aware CRDT for magazine layout, LWW for non-conflicting fields. Tab-close confirmation on dirty state.

completion_criteria: WCAG 2.1 AA passing on all PPG pages; axe-core CI gate green
Every interactive element ≥44×44 px on shop-tablet validation
Full keyboard nav verified; screen reader compatible
Operator-voice copy reviewed by ≥3 operators; locked in i18n
Undo/redo + autosave + multi-operator conflict resolution work end-to-end
